tool.name: Downsample validpairs
tool.description: Randomly downsample a validpairs file using shuf (single-pass, fast)

param.name: input
param.label: Input validpairs file
param.help: Tab-separated validpairs file, optionally with ## header lines

param.name: n_lines
param.label: Number of lines to keep
param.help: e.g. 1000000 to keep 1 million read pairs

tool.help:
**What it does**
Randomly downsamples a ``.validpairs`` file using the Linux ``shuf`` utility. Single-pass and fast — suitable for files with tens of millions of lines.
Header lines starting with ``#`` are always preserved.
